subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: DIC, Vasa Praevia and Placenta Accreta Spectrum

steps.tx: Widespread clotting activation consuming platelets and factors until bleeding erupts is **DIC**. Disseminated intravascular coagulation in obstetrics follows abruption, sepsis, embolism and dead fetus retention. Treating the cause plus replacing components is the twin strategy. A dead fetus retained over four to five weeks is the classic slow trigger, releasing thromboplastin gradually.
steps.say: DIC consumes clotting factors after abruption or sepsis and needs cause treatment plus replacement.

steps.tx: Fetal vessels running in membranes across the internal os are **vasa praevia**. They tear when membranes rupture, exsanguinating the fetus within minutes. Antenatal diagnosis by targeted scan converts a catastrophe into a planned caesarean. Type two has a succenturiate lobe or velamentous vessels; type one sits directly over the os with no lobe abnormality.
steps.say: Vasa praevia tears fetal vessels at membrane rupture and exsanguinates the fetus.

steps.tx: Fetal haemorrhage from torn vasa praevia is historically called **Benckiser haemorrhage**. A small volume of vaginal blood with immediate fetal heart collapse is the signature. The mother stays well while the fetus bleeds to death. The total fetal blood volume is only about 80 to 100 millilitres per kilogram, so 50 millilitres lost is catastrophic.
steps.say: Benckiser haemorrhage bleeds the fetus from torn vasa while the mother stays well.

steps.tx: Placenta growing into uterine muscle without its normal cleavage plane forms **placenta accreta spectrum**. Previous caesarean plus praevia is the classic setup. Undiagnosed cases cause the most torrential haemorrhage in obstetrics. Grades run accreta, increta and percreta by depth, and most modern cases follow caesarean scars.
steps.say: Placenta accreta spectrum grows into muscle without a cleavage plane after caesarean scars.

vis.alt: Accreta risk with praevia over scar.
vis.caption: Accreta spectrum risk. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: Diagnosis before delivery transforms outcomes, so high risk women get a dedicated **accreta scan**. Loss of the clear zone, bladder wall interruption and placental lacunae are ultrasound markers. MRI clarifies parametrial and bladder invasion. Placental lacunae look like moth eaten holes with turbulent flow, and their number tracks invasion depth.
steps.say: A dedicated accreta scan seeks clear zone loss and bladder interruption in high risk women.

steps.tx: Planned caesarean hysterectomy leaving the placenta undisturbed is the standard for major accreta, termed **planned hysterectomy**. Attempting placental removal first provokes uncontrollable bleeding. Cell salvage, interventional radiology and massive transfusion stand ready. Delivery is planned at 34 to 36 weeks in a centre with interventional radiology and cell salvage ready.
steps.say: Planned hysterectomy leaving the placenta undisturbed is standard for major accreta.

steps.tx: In obstetric coagulopathy one blood product is replaced before the others. **Fibrinogen first** is the rule because fibrinogen falls earliest and furthest in amniotic fluid embolism, abruption and dilution, and low levels predict severe bleeding. Cryoprecipitate or fibrinogen concentrate therefore leads the pack order while red cells restore oxygen carriage. A fibrinogen result sent early and repeated often turns transfusion from guesswork into a guided sequence.
steps.say: Fibrinogen falls first in obstetric coagulopathy, so it is replaced first. Early repeated levels turn transfusion into a guided sequence.

vis.alt: Image showing fibrinogen replacement prioritised in obstetric disseminated intravascular coagulation.
vis.caption: Fibrinogen concentrate is shown at the front of a massive transfusion pack order. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Fibrinogen is the first factor to fall and the best guide in obstetric DIC, a principle of **fibrinogen first**. Levels under two grams per litre predict severe haemorrhage. Concentrate or cryoprecipitate restores it fastest. Cryoprecipitate contains fibrinogen plus factor eight, and ten units raise the level usefully in most women.
steps.say: Fibrinogen first falls earliest in obstetric DIC and levels under two predict severity.

steps.tx: Rotational thromboelastometry at the bedside guides component therapy in real time, called **viscoelastic testing**. It shows clot strength and fibrinolysis within minutes. Targeted products replace blind ratio based transfusion increasingly. A FIBTEM amplitude at ten minutes under 12 millimetres is a common trigger for fibrinogen in obstetric protocols.
steps.say: Viscoelastic testing guides component therapy in real time at the bedside.

steps.tx: Velamentous cord insertion and succenturiate lobes predispose to vasa praevia, grouped as **anatomical predispositions**. Targeted transvaginal colour Doppler at the anomaly scan finds vessels over the os. Elective caesarean at thirty four to thirty six weeks follows diagnosis. Serial growth scans follow diagnosis, because these placentas also carry higher growth restriction risk.
steps.say: Velamentous insertion predisposes to vasa praevia needing elective caesarean after diagnosis.
